body: US-001 notes said 'Do NOT touch scripts/cam/patterns.md'. The worker did not edit the referenced CAM-301 bullet but appended a new resolution bullet documenting that the auditor now BLOCKs the antipattern. This is additive and consistent with cam's knowledge-routing convention (append a bullet for a new reusable insight), so it is non-blocking; noting only as a minor deviation from the literal PRD note.
